name: Coding assessment
models: Reported, as of Nov 2026: online coding tests at JP Morgan, Two Sigma and Goldman Sachs. Two Python algorithm problems in 60 minutes, for quant, software and strats roles.
description: This is the reported format of an online coding assessment, as candidates described it by Nov 2026. You have two algorithm problems in 60 minutes and write both in Python. The first is medium and the second is harder. Hidden tests include large inputs, so a slow answer fails them. A problem scores only when all its hidden tests pass. The results panel lists each test, so use it to see how far you got. The two problems are drawn afresh from a pool each time you sit. The pool is also in the drill library. Use no search engine and no notes. Read both statements and plan your minutes first.
